data.one_liner: Animated list widget that updates automatically based on list changes.
data.what_it_does: DeclarativeList builds list items with animations that react to changes in the underlying data. It uses a DiffUtil-like algorithm to compute insertions, removals, and moves, applying fade and size transitions.
use_when: You need an animated list that updates automatically when the data changes.
You prefer a declarative approach over manual animation handling.
You want to customize insertion and removal animations via builders.
avoid_when: You require extremely high-performance lists with thousands of items.
You need complex item animations that cannot be expressed with simple FadeTransition and SizeTransition.
strengths: Declarative API simplifies list animation logic.
Built-in diff algorithm reduces boilerplate for insert/remove/move handling.
Supports custom builders for insertion and removal animations.
weaknesses: Limited to list-type widgets; not suitable for grids or other layouts.
Animation options are basic; complex animations require custom widgets.
